subject: Repeat trial/credit requests — ClearSight AI (investigation)
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@clearsight.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request for additional trial credits for ClearSight POC

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the help so far. Our engineering teams ran into capacity issues during the POC and several engineers fell off the shared trial. Would it be possible to grant another round of trial credits for two additional seats so we can complete the benchmark across our data pipeline? We’re trying to compare latency and per-token costs against our current provider and need a clean window to run batch jobs.

Account: ClearSight AI
Primary contact: Tom Reynolds (me)
Use case: internal evaluation for feature extraction + reranking

Happy to take a short call if helpful. Thanks — Tom

Tom Reynolds
Director of ML Engineering | ClearSight AI
tr@clearsight.ai
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for additional trial credits for ClearSight POC

Tom —

Thanks for the note and context. I can usually approve small extensions for active POCs, but I noticed a few anomalies in ClearSight’s trial history while looking up the account (multiple short-lived trial top-ups across different signups). To keep things straightforward and avoid interrupting your work, I’ve looped in Ben from fraud ops and Marissa (my manager) to confirm.

Can you confirm the following quickly so we can move fast?
- Which team(s) need the seats and how many concurrent users per seat?
- Are these runs using shared API keys or per-developer keys?
- Procurement contact (email) for us to validate billing/legal if we escalate to a pilot purchase

If you can share the procurement contact or a short screenshot of the current trial dashboard, Ben can do a light review and we’ll aim to respond today.

Thanks — Soojin

Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: ClearSight — preliminary fraud scan results

Soojin / team —

I pulled the account signals and did a quick correlate across signup fingerprints. Summary:
- Found 3 distinct accounts associated with the ClearSight domain created in the last 6 weeks, all requesting trial top-ups within 48 hours of prior expirations.
- Payment method overlap: two accounts used the same masked card sequence (last 4 digits match).
- Traffic pattern: bursts of short-duration heavy token generation during off hours, consistent with scripted benchmark runs.

I attached the raw session log and top-up history for your records (session-log.csv, topup-history.pdf). Recommend we pause issuing additional credits until procurement confirms this is a coordinated enterprise POC and not parallel multi-account attempts to game credits.

Action recommendation: Freeze further credit grants, request procurement verification, offer an alternative — a short timeboxed dedicated pilot (reserved capacity) with contract/commit if they want repeated runs.

Ben Carter
Fraud & Abuse Ops | Redwood Inference
[attachment: session-log.csv]
[attachment: topup-history.pdf]
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2027 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for additional trial credits for ClearSight POC

Tom —

Quick update after Ben’s review: we flagged multiple linked trials and overlapping payment info that look like coordinated top-ups rather than a single team’s extended evaluation. To protect both sides, we need procurement to confirm this is a sanctioned POC before we add more free credits.

Options so we can get you unblocked quickly:
1) Procurement verification: if your procurement/legal team can confirm a pilot (email from procure@clearsight.ai or a short PO), we’ll approve a one-time trial extension for the two seats you requested.
2) Short dedicated pilot: we can provision a 7-day reserved pilot environment (limited capacity but stable performance) — this requires a simple pilot SOW and short payment/commit (we can draft). It removes the need for repeated free top-ups and gives you consistent performance metrics.

If you prefer to continue with credits, please have procurement reply to this thread (procure@clearsight.ai is fine). Otherwise, I can schedule a 20-minute call with Ben and Neha to scope the reserved pilot and cost estimate.

We’ll hold on issuing any credits until we have procurement confirmation. Appreciate the quick turnaround — hope we can get you the runs you need.

Best,
Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@clearsight.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2027 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for additional trial credits for ClearSight POC

Soojin —

Understood. Apologies for the noise — those earlier signups were team-level quick trials spun up by separate engineers without procurement oversight. I’ve looped procurement (procure@clearsight.ai) on this thread; they’ll reply with the PO/confirmation later today. If you can provision a one-time two-seat extension once procurement responds, that would be ideal.

If procurement asks about pilot terms, please point them to me and I’ll sign off. Happy to take a short call with Ben to walk through the usage patterns.

Thanks for the thorough check — Tom

Tom Reynolds
